description: List a Jandy AquaLink RS panel’s OneTouch scenes — the panel-defined one-button macros such as "Spa Mode", "All OFF" or "Clean Mode" — with each scene’s number, label and whether it is on, read through iAqualink WebTouch (the panel emulation). Use iaqualink_set_onetouch to run or stop one.
name: iaqualink_list_onetouch
